desc: The custody domain tracks the documentary handoffs themselves rather than the objects. Its findings on this board are mostly negative and that is the point: To The Stars Academy's own chief operating officer, a former Lockheed Skunk Works advanced systems director, publicly conceded that the ADAM materials had been 'collected from sources with varying levels of chain-of-custody documentation'. The DIA-funded AAWSAP DIRD series is exemplary at documenting the flow of paper - control numbers, fiscal years, named programme managers, contractor addresses - and silent on the flow of objects. No released document in the AAWSAP corpus records the receipt, transfer or storage of a physical sample. That asymmetry is the single most important structural observation in this domain: the government's own released record proves that it commissioned propulsion theory, materials science and injury pathology, and proves nothing about what it was holding while it did so.
